answer: Persistent challenge thread. Each identity must answer a fresh, unpredictable liveness challenge within a short window, and answers form a chained thread only computable by continuous polling; missed windows void it. A zephyr-like stream of microtasks forces sustained presence, not one-time setup. Because solving requires ongoing attention, an attacker operating many identities pays a glacier of accumulating person-hours; parallelism is capped by human throughput, so marginal identities cost real labor. Spam collapses under attention debt.
